title.narrative: Women in climate resilient Agri Systems for enhanced Nutrition Security

description.narrative: Overall objective:Contribution to fostering climate-resilient local food systems and empowering women in the mountain district of AchhamOutcome:2,500 predominantly women-headed marginalized farmer households in two communities in Achham district have improved their nutritional situation and are empowered to exercise their rights in the areas of nutrition and climate change.

The main objective of this project is to contribute to fostering climate-resilient local food systems and empowering women in the mountain district of Achham. The project site is five wards in Safebagar (Ward Numbers 2, 3, 9, 10, and 14) and 4 wards in Chaurpati (Ward Numbers 4, 5, 6, 7) rural municipalities of the Achham district of Suderpaschim, directly benefitting 2500 marginalized HHs. It also aims to strengthen the capacities of CBOs, and CSOs, so that they can represent marginalized households in exercising their rights in the areas of nutrition and climate change.

The project will target marginalised households with low socio-economic status and who are nutrition and climate vulnerable poor, in particular female headed households and Dalits as defined by: (1) low income and food shortage; (2) reliance on subsistence agriculture and small land size0.5 ha; (3) social discrimination/marginalisation and (4) low access to government services, technology, and assets.Institutional target groups are the 27 local CBOs and three CSOs networks and the two municipalities with their nine Wards (= sub-section with several villages forming one ward), 5 cooperatives and the three local partner NGOs.Indirect target groups: 110 government female community health volunteers (FCHVs), the 15 agricultural technicians, 2 women development officers.
